_doc: Per-candidate audit verdicts. status: accept | reject | uncertain.
_audit_rubric: ACCEPT iff: (a) KCSAN/lockdep report clearly identifies two distinct execution contexts in the stack traces, AND (b) the upstream fix uses real synchronization primitives (lock/atomic/READ_ONCE+WRITE_ONCE/smp_*/per-CPU/per-netns conversion that removes shared state), AND (c) the parent commit exists in our linux.git so the vulnerable source is extractable.

REJECT if the patch is only data_race() annotation, only ASSERT_EXCLUSIVE_*, only defensive input validation, or removes a lock with no replacement. These are marked benign by the maintainers and should not be in a 'concurrency defect' dataset.

Fix wraps the racy read in a new helper protected by krcp->lock.
SYZBOT-061d370693bdd99f.notes: Subject: rcu/kvfree: Fix data-race in __mod_timer / kvfree_call_rcu. Patch adds raw_spin_lock_irqsave(&krcp->lock).
